notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/farama-foundation__mo-gymnasium --backend fake; every gate G1 to G9 passed, evidence is contract_checked and never an MHS-Device level. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached, no hardware backend exists for this simulated R0 device and no hardware run is claimed. The card is a driver pack: this package covers one of its five entry symbols, fishwood-v0 (mo_gymnasium.envs.fishwood.fishwood:FishWood, registered at mo_gymnasium/envs/fishwood/__init__.py:4-7), and NOT COVERED: the other four entry symbols, BreakableBottles (mo_gymnasium/envs/breakable_bottles/breakable_bottles.py:12), MOContinuousMountainCar (mo_gymnasium/envs/continuous_mountain_car/continuous_mountain_car.py:12), DeepSeaTreasure (mo_gymnasium/envs/deep_sea_treasure/deep_sea_treasure.py:89) and FourRoom (mo_gymnasium/envs/four_room/four_room.py:34), all named in facts.md. The contract is derived from the environment's spaces: cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action} with action.index 0 to 1 (Discrete(2)), cap.world.reset.v1 takes {seed, options}, cap.world.seed.v1 takes {seed}, and the observation is the one-value Box(0..1) state (0 fishing, 1 in the woods); the episode ends at MAX_TS = 200 and the fidelity is F0, timestep_ms 0 (turn-based), seeded with seed_control parameter. NOT COVERED: the 2-objective reward vector of MO-Gymnasium in the step output. cap.world.step.v1's reward is a single number, so the fake returns the sum of the two one-hot objectives (0 or 1, the number of resources collected in the step) as the scalar reward and keeps the full [fish, wood] vector in info.objectives, which mhs.resource.read serves; the vector is absent from the step receipt, and the fidelity gaps say so. NOT COVERED: the sim backend. A backend name that backends does not list is gymnasium.make(env_id) in GymnasiumDriver.open_native, but that call needs mo_gymnasium imported so the id is registered, and it was not run where the gate runs (the clone needs gymnasium, numpy and pygame-ce, pyproject.toml:24-28). NOT COVERED: any comparison of the fake with the upstream environment; the fake re-implements the two-state transition and the Bernoulli reward in pure Python with random.Random(seed) instead of numpy's np_random, so one seed gives different reward sequences on the two (fidelity gaps); rendering, pygame assets and snapshot/restore are not modelled because the class exposes no get_state/set_state. The gate warnings are the expected ones of a Gymnasium family driver (PLAYBOOK.md section 8): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1, which arms the next reset and makes no native call, and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index, and seed twice). There is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. No exemplar Fact, Limit, name or comment was kept: driver.py, fake.py, facts.md and test_driver.py were written for this repository. Only the catalogue's cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. Gate runs used: 4; the first version of the package covered DeepSeaTreasure and failed G8 because the conformance probe action ended the episode, so the package was rewritten around FishWood. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
